name: MHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Clinton, MS · Choctaw Trails, Mississippi College
headline: MHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Thursday, 1A–3A: St. Andrew’s Episcopal swept 3A, the boys with 22 points behind champion Jackson Jumper (16:43.87) and the girls with 31 behind champion Evelyn Spellings (19:39.08). 2A: Myrtle won the boys title (60) and Enterprise-Clarke the girls (44); Wesson’s Dalton Jackson (17:34.90) and Myrtle’s Ally Murphy (19:43.71) won the individual titles. 1A: French Camp won the boys (36) behind champion Matthew Simmons (16:34.77), and Tupelo Christian won the girls (30) with a 1-2-3 led by Alexia Fleming (20:48.78). 4A–7A race Saturday.
